0022600022.text: The Timberwolves (3-2, 1-1 at home, 8th in the West and 1 game back of 3rd in the Northwest) host the Clippers (1-3, 12th in the West and 2.5 games back of 4th in the Pacific) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, with Minnesota coming off two straight losses and LA on a three-game skid. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), who is averaging 33.3 points per game this season, and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), while the Clippers are missing Bradley Beal (knee, inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Max Strus (foot, plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on March 11, 2026, in Los Angeles, where the Timberwolves lost 153-128.
